title: Pigtails & Crewcuts Opens New Snellville, Georgia Location
content: Pigtails & Crewcuts, which saw double-digit year-over-year growth in 2025, is a leader in the kids’ salon space. It partners with owners who share core values of working with integrity and respect, being fun and compassionate, and delivering consistent quality to every family that walks through the door. It partners with owners who share core values of working with integrity and respect, being fun and compassionate, and delivering consistent quality to every family that walks through the door. [...] “Our growth is rooted in finding the right people who believe that the people matter most,” said Michelle Holliman, Vice President of Franchise Development. “Pigtails & Crewcuts is a recession-resilient brand because we provide a necessary service with a heart. We are thrilled to welcome Douaa and Said to our close-knit franchise community and look forward to seeing them establish the premier kids’ salon destination in Snellville.”
